validity.recommendation: Human de-dup/segmentation review of the UBTG-1 km-post cluster: confirm against Aramco/route data whether the km0->km56 stretch carries TWO physical parallel pipes (P1910 dia=48 + P1911 dia=40) or whether P1911 is a double-count of P1910. If a single line, merge P1911 into P1910. Also record the existence caveat: no independent source names this km-post segment.
validity.researcher_notes: P1911 'UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56 2 Gas Pipeline' is the '2' (parallel) line on the EXACT same corridor as P1910 'UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56 Gas Pipeline': identical trunk (UBTG-1), identical km-post span (km0->km56), identical length (56 km), same owner (Saudi Aramco), differing ONLY in diameter (P1910=48 in vs P1911=40 in). This is a classic parallel-line-vs-double-count ambiguity. Different diameters weakly argue for two genuine looped pipes (a copy-paste double-count would repeat the diameter), but NO source confirms two physical lines exist on this stretch. EXISTENCE weakness (documented, not the headline verdict because the UBTG-1 trunk corridor itself is real): the sheet's only citations for this row (wiki_citations.json) are two GENERIC OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletins (ASB 2012 p.75; ASB 2017 p.136) that do NOT name this pipeline or its km-post segments. Every web hit for 'UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56 2' is a gem.wiki page (GEM-derived, cannot cite). GulfPub PE World Map -- Saudi Arabia's BEST-covered independent reference (20 gas features) -- lists NO UBTG line at all (it has Qatif-Berri, Abqaiq-Qatif, East-West, MGS 2/3, Fadhili, Jafurah -- none of the UBTG km-post family). So the entire UBTG-1 km-post decomposition (P1898/P1899/P1900/P1901/P1908/P1910/P1911/P1912) appears to be a GEM-internal segmentation of one Aramco sales-gas trunk (UBTG = Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas, linking the Uthmaniyah/Hawiyah gas plants north to Berri/Juaymah), not a set of independently named pipelines. CLASSIFICATION: correct as a gas (sales-gas) transmission trunk segment -- not oil/NGL, not plant-internal. ATTRIBUTION: Owner/operator Saudi Aramco 100% is consistent with the whole Master Gas System being Aramco-owned and -operated; fine. SPEC: length 56 km is tautological (it is the km0->km56 span, not an independently measured value); diameter 40 in and the blank capacity are NOT independently verifiable -- no non-GEM source states them, so none can be confirmed. The two proposed_refs below (Saudipedia Hawiyah and Berri gas plant pages) are independent of GEM and confirm the CORRIDOR ENDPOINT FACILITIES exist, but they do NOT name this pipeline or its specs -- included only as corridor corroboration, hence tier=low.

routes.start_name: UBTG-1 km0 (Uthmaniyah/Hawiyah gas plant area, Ghawar field, Eastern Province)
routes.end_name: UBTG-1 km56 (unnamed interior km-post ~56 km north along the UBTG-1 trunk toward Berri/Juaymah)
routes.corridor_desc: UBTG (Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas) line 1 is an Aramco sales-gas trunk running from the Uthmaniyah/Hawiyah gas-plant complex in the southern Ghawar field (Eastern Province) generally NORTH toward the Berri and Juaymah gas plants near Jubail on the Persian Gulf coast (per the adjacent GEM rows: P1912 Hawiyah->km0, P1900 km56->AY-1 KP916, P1898/P1899 UBTG-1->Berri, P1901 UBTG-1->Juaymah). This row is the km0->km56 stretch: the southernmost ~56 km of that trunk, starting near the Hawiyah/Uthmaniyah plants. LOOSELY bounded -- km0 and km56 are interior km-posts, not named facilities, so only the start anchor (gas-plant area, ~24.6-25.0 N, 49.2-49.4 E) is sourceable; km56 is ~56 km north of it along the corridor but its exact point is unsourced. start_lat/lon are approximate (Hawiyah gas plant area, a named place); end coordinates left null to avoid fabrication.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established indirectly from the UBTG-1 km-post naming scheme across the sibling GEM rows plus independent Saudipedia confirmation that the Hawiyah gas plant (start anchor) and Berri gas plant (corridor terminus) exist in the Eastern Province. km0 start coordinate is the Hawiyah/Uthmaniyah gas-plant area (approximate, defensible from a named place); km56 end is an unnamed interior post ~56 km north -- coordinate deliberately left null rather than fabricated. Corridor direction (south Ghawar -> Berri/Juaymah coast) is well supported; exact alignment is not, hence low.
